title: Otori Emu — Happy Birthday!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... That third piece of paper mentioned a “smile-filled wonderland”. It meant SEKAI right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I don't see Miku or anyone else. Where are they?

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
Right here☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku & KAITO
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wh-Wh-Whoa...! I'm being showered with so many flowers...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: These flowers are from all of us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We wanted to really surprise you, so we made lots and lots of them♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! You guys made all these?! That makes me super duper extra happy with a cherry on top!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, where are the others?
I really wanna thank them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Guess what?! MEIKO and the others are busy putting together a secret...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: M-Miku!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: E-Emu, you actually have one last assignment to complete! So, you should take a look at this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: One last assignment?! Lemme see! Lemme see!

rows.Speaker: Written Assignment
rows.Line:
“Congratulations of making it this far.
This will be your final assignment... Or is it?”

rows.Speaker: Written Assignment
rows.Line: “Have you figured who we are yet?”

rows.Speaker: Written Assignment
rows.Line: “We'll be awaiting you at the stage where it all began!!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The stage where it all began...?!
That means the people who wrote these are...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your dear friends are waiting for you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup yup☆
With something even more fun and explosive than our flower shower...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ahem, so! Please come back to SEKAI in a little bit!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Roger dodger! I'll be back for sure!
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa! Nene! Rui!
I'm heeeeere!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Private Emu! Congratulations on making it this far!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let us begin by rewarding you for reaching the end.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ready?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Nene & Rui
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Emu!
Emu, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Thank you all so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!!
Y-You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're here?! Even after celebrating at school?! And you have fireworks?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. They're for your birthday party, Emu. We figured that we should prepare a big one since you'd have so many of your friends here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And we really need to thank Azusawa and all of you for helping us out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We wanted to see you guys' surprise to go off without a hitch, so I'm really glad that you invited us to join you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa, does that mean you guys wrote all those assignments?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Correct! And Nene was the one suggested that we do something special to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This was your idea, Nene?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um, well...
I knew you liked surprises, so I thought that it could be fun...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But Tsukasa and the others are the ones who gathered everyone to help...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hahahaha!
I ended up pulling all the strings I could as a star.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Tsukasa asked Saki who then asked everybody at Miya Girls. Also, we had Mr. Mascot contact your brothers and such to see if they'd lend us a hand.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Saki, as well as the rest of you!
Thank you for helping us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It was fun to be able to celebrate together like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll always be up for fun events like this! Especially if it's a dear friend's birthday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Saki, Honami, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I... I love you all so much...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Cry*
Nene!! Thank you sooo much for coming up with this surprise!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
D-Don't throw yourself at me like that. You almost knocked me over.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But... But...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't tell us that you're satisfied with just this, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. This party's just getting started.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! But you guys have already done so much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes!
So, let's get on stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're going to mark this very special occasion by putting on a show that's going to blow the socks off everyone here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A show?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: W-Wait, you never said anything about doing a show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course we're doing a show!
An authentic surprise performance by none other than us, Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...! Wait, what kind of show are we gonna do?! Can I see the script?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, we don't actually have one for you. As such, you'll be free to do as you please throughout our performance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: As I please?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. We have a basic story for the beginning, but how our show ends is gonna depend on how you improvise after that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Th-That sounds super fun!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We normally don't get to put on shows like these, so you're free to have as much fun as you possibly can!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I will!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, Emu, to the stage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay♪
Up we go...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(From up here...
Everyone's smiles look so sparkly...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, are you ready?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They put a big smile on my face, so now it's my turn to do the same for them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't want today to be just about me... I want to make it a super special day for everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: It's showtime!!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Otori.
I know it was brief, but I'm glad we had a chance to talk.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Your fun and energetic personality has this way of cheering up everybody around you, so I hope that doesn't change moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Otori.
I'm glad you enjoyed our surprise.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And you seemed to really like the snacks we got for you as your present. We really talked a lot about what to get you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We did. Which why we tried gathering all the snacks we could that were yummy and also looked fun to eat or play with!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! And the box for your present looked like it was about to burst after we crammed everything in!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. But we managed to tie it up with a nice bow, Emu, so please be careful when you open it. Everything inside may come flying out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! Actually, she'd probably really enjoy that! Now, Airi, if you will♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Once again, Emu, happy birthday!
I'm glad that I was able to celebrate with you like this! It turned out to be a really great party!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And that show you did for us was something else! It was amazing how it was mostly improvised!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. You and your troupe mates were in perfect sync with one another. We came to throw you a party but ended up being the ones that were entertained.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It definitely felt like a birthday party that was thrown just for you, Otori. It was also easy to tell how much you love shows and seeing everyone smile.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Totally. I hope you get more and more chances to make people smile with your shows, Emu. I'll be looking forward to seeing what you have in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha! As a stage performer, there's nothing better than evoking that feeling of surprise and excitement in others, and putting smile on their faces!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. And were able to do that because everybody was kind enough to join us to celebrate Emu's special day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, she has so many friends too.
Having Hoshino and the others to help out was nice, but I was so nervous when I asked them about this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it was worth it in the end, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Especially since I got to see Emu smile so much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, Emu, happy birthday!
Let's keep putting on the best shows ever and make as many people as we can smile!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Emu!
I'm guessing you had a lovely day. I could tell when you returned home today.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Your head was more in the clouds than usual.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, but I believe helping with that surprise was worth it.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. We're happy to see you surrounded by so many wonderful friends. I hope you get to have lots of fun with them in the future!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Today was suuuch a super duper incredibly amazing day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene and the others helped come up with ideas...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And Saki and everyone else even lent them a hand, so I love them even more now☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I have to take all the happiness I was showered with today and share it with everyone who comes to see our shows!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna keep doing everything I can show give them the most wonderhoy shows possible! Yeah!
